title: Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid: "malak" (messenger) before the Name
summary: The Genesis 22:15-16 letter grid now shows the word מלאך (malak, "messenger") in purple in a row ahead of the letters of the Name יהוה, with the same blue diagonal box through א ה י ה. The right side repeats the row, the hashem letters and the green-boxed ש, with the large purple word מלאך and the labels "malak" and "messenger" at the bottom.

text.text: מ ל א ך י ה ו ה

pictures.description: Grid of Hebrew letters (the text of Genesis 22:15-16 in rows) with the word מלאך in purple, the letters of יהוה in red, blue and orange, a blue diagonal box, and a green rectangle around one row.

Extracted letters on the right: the row מלאך יהוה with מלאך in purple, the blue letters ה ש מ and ס, a blue diagonal box through four letters, a green box around ש and י, and the large purple word מלאך below.

uncertain: Dense letter grid not copied cell by cell; only the highlighted letters and labels are transcribed.
The final letter of מלאך in the grid is drawn like ך (final kaf).
